snippet.title: A Story of Questions - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to A Story of Questions a psychological horror mystery where you solve puzzles, make difficult choices, and uncover something deeply unsettling.

After its debut at the Deutsche Indie Games Showcase, I'm thrilled to finally share the official trailer for my upcoming game with you all! As a solo indie developer, this project is very special for me :-)
